subject: Geography
assessment_title: Geography Grade 12 Term 2 Controlled Assessment Pack

visual_blueprint.subject: Geography
assessment_content_focus: settlement patterns, land use, urban problems and sustainability
interpreting maps, photographs, data tables and case evidence
structured extended response on human-environment interaction

required_visuals.title: Map extract with legend, scale, north arrow and labelled features

generation_constraints: Every question must be answerable from the stated term focus, supplied stimulus and grade-appropriate subject knowledge.
Educator approval is required before classroom use.

sections.title: Section A: Map And Source Skills
sections.instructions: Use the supplied map, photograph, diagram or graph.
sections.stimulus: Geography source set linked to rural and urban settlement geography.

questions.question: Identify TWO visible spatial patterns or features from the source.
Explain the process or relationship shown in the source.
Interpret the supplied data table or graph and describe the trend.

sections.title: Section B: Geographic Explanation
sections.stimulus: Explanation focus: settlement patterns, land use, urban problems and sustainability.

questions.question: Compare two places, processes or patterns using source evidence.
Suggest a sustainable response to the geographic challenge.

sections.title: Section C: Integrated Mapwork Or GIS
sections.stimulus: Integrated focus: structured extended response on human-environment interaction.

questions.question: Complete an integrated spatial reasoning task using map/data evidence.

rubric.descriptor: Answers are clear, complete and structured.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm CAPS term and topic fit before classroom use.
Insert or approve final source material where the pack requests educator-supplied sources.
Check mark allocation, memo wording and learner level.
Confirm visuals are suitable and not treated as official source material unless sourced separately.
